agent_explanation: Light fast body (m=1, vx~-48) strikes near-stationary heavy body (m~16.9). Between step 6 (separated, energy ~1790) and step 7 (touching gap 0.046) the contact impulse/positional correction creates large spurious velocity: heavy body jumps to speed ~51 (vx~-43.8, vy~-26.6) and light body keeps speed ~45 instead of bouncing, raising x-momentum ~16x and energy 1790->23888 with zero controller work. The spurious -y kick despite zero pre-impact relative y-velocity points to normal impulse/positional-correction energy injection on a fast heavy-light contact, not to external work or restitution (both e<1).
